nativeInk.qualification: Source-tree/PNG/rigidity/purity verification. Complete alpha coverage of all64 rigs is not certified. Historical unmeasured gaps are qualified only when source file/SHA/dimensions/bytes, selected source ID, imageScale, textureRotation, rect and clip are byte-exact under the same baseline fixture. Only offset and detachment.anchor placement differences are allowed, with exact before/after values listed; matrices/joints/detachment checks remain separate and strict. New raster inputs and posed keys require measured records, and all9 newly active keys resolve without fallback across36 owner fixtures. Historical and current gap histograms include every sampled fixture without creating or admitting alpha fallback records. It does not certify visible seam coverage, canonical camera, extracted original animation or world-space support without a measured owner context.
